text:
sofia: FYI — PineTree Inc wants a short presales pack: EU+CA residency, sub-processor roster, SCCs, and an egress delta for quoting. Can we pull together a one-pager + SOW checklist?
ben: Do they accept pinned hosted or is on-prem/dedicated required?
sofia: They prefer pinned hosted to move fast but must have BYOK and explicit no-US-data-plane transfer unless stated.
ada: quick legal note: our control plane may orchestrate from us-east1 by default. We should call that out and offer Private deploy as zero-control-plane option.
ben: Current data-plane subprocessors in EU/CA: GCP (compute & storage), Fastly (edge cache), optional HashiCorp Vault for BYOK, and Sentry (errors, minimal). Will confirm cert links.
trent: For egress adjustment, ballpark multipliers: ca-central1 +19%, eu-west1 +11%, uk(europe-west2) +10%. Use those as placeholders in the quote and mark as "estimate".
sofia: Can ops provide a CSV with subproc name, country, transfer_direction (yes/no), and cert URL? I need to attach to security questionnaire.
answers-bot: Note: Standard SCC annex available at https://redwood.example.com/security/scc.pdf
ben: Also add a recommended routing snippet for the SOW:
```
routing_policy:
  preferred_regions: [eu-west1, europe-west2, ca-central1]
  data_plane: pinned
  control_plane: hosted(us-east1) # private deployment available on request
  kms: BYOK_supported
  egress_estimate: { ca-central1: 1.19, eu-west1: 1.11, europe-west2: 1.10 }
```
sofia: Customer asked if we can run a 2% EU+CA canary for 24-48hrs to validate latency before full cutover. Any infra blockers?
trent: Canary on pinned hosted is fine. Recommend dedicated/reserved if they want guaranteed tail latency under burst; otherwise SLOs are best-effort.
ada: For the Q "Do you transfer customer data outside their selected region?" suggested reply: "Data plane is pinned to customer-selected regions. Control-plane orchestration metadata may traverse other regions; Private deployments remove this behavior. See attached attestation and SCC annex."
sofia: Great. Ben/Trent — please drop the CSV + attestation links and final egress numbers by EOD so I can ship the SOW. :thumbsup:
